explanation: Sundial, Hourglass, Clock, and Calendar are all instruments or systems used to measure or track the passage of time. A Thermometer is used to measure temperature.

Compass, Gunpowder, Papermaking, and Printing are widely recognized as the Four Great Inventions of Ancient China. The Steam Engine was a pivotal invention of the Industrial Revolution, originating in the West much later.

Four of the words form another common English word when spelled backwards: Desserts (Stressed), Live (Evil), Bat (Tab), Loop (Pool). 'Table' spelled backwards ('Elbat') does not form a common English word.
